Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

lgr (development version)

Added

  • Docs: Add a SKILL.md documenting how to use lgr in R packages, and use_skill() to install it into a project’s coding-agent config directory (auto-detecting .claude/, .cursor/, .codex/, and other supported presets, or accepting an explicit agent/path)

  • Docs: Complete rewrite of the code documentation and update ro roxygen2 8.0

  • Docs: Refresh the pkgdown site: update the CI workflow to match the current r-lib/actions template (newer action versions, SHA-pinned deploy action), regenerate favicons, review the reference index for completeness, and add per-pull-request preview site deployments with an auto-updating PR comment linking to the preview

  • Filter: Add FilterInjectSystemInfo, a FilterInject subclass that automatically injects standard runtime metadata (hostName, rVersion, containerId when running in Docker, scriptFile when determinable) into every log event once at construction time, in addition to any custom values supplied via .../.list

Changed

  • Breaking: Complete overhaul of the logging config file system. Replace the undocumented Logger: shorthand and hidden multi-logger logging_config format with a single, documented, exported declarative configuration format (version: 1). Drop the top-level Logger: key and put settings under loggers: {root: {...}}; replace implicit ClassName: keys with an explicit class: key (e.g. AppenderConsole: {threshold: info} becomes {class: AppenderConsole, threshold: info}). A plain list of already-constructed objects passed to Logger$config() continues to work unchanged for a single logger. See vignette("lgr", package = "lgr") and ?config for the format reference and a migration guide

  • Config: Function-valued constructor arguments (ref:/code:) are no longer limited to a logger’s exception_handler and filter entries – any layouts/filters/appenders constructor argument (e.g. a LayoutJson’s transform_event) now accepts the same forms

  • Config: Add an enabled key to component and logger definitions so a sink or logger can be toggled via ${VAR:-false} interpolation without adding or removing YAML blocks; a disabled logger is fully reset to its default/unconfigured state, keeping re-application idempotent regardless of prior state

Fixed

  • Appender: Fix $remove_appenders() removing the wrong appenders when removing multiple indices at once (thx @m-muecke)

  • AppenderFileRotating: Fix $format() returning an invalid value instead of FALSE for the colour default (thx @m-muecke)

  • Docs: Fix a couple of documentation typos (thx @m-muecke)

  • Filter: Fix FilterInject$new() erroring when called with values supplied only via .list and no named ... arguments

  • LayoutJson: Fix $set_transform_event_names() rejecting a named list of scalar character values, as produced when a YAML/JSON mapping is parsed (e.g. a transform_event_names: block in a declarative config)

  • Filter: Fix $remove_filters() removing the wrong filters when removing multiple indices at once (thx @m-muecke)

  • Layout: Fix an incorrect sprintf() call in the unknown-level warning of LayoutFormat$read() (thx @m-muecke)

  • LayoutJson: Fix $set_transform_event_names() not returning self, which broke method chaining (thx @m-muecke)

  • Logger: Fix add_log_levels() not showing the name of the overwritten level in its message (thx @m-muecke)

  • Logger: Fix basic_config() not validating the memory argument against itself (thx @m-muecke)

  • logger_tree: Fix subtle styling not being disabled when color = FALSE (thx @m-muecke)

lgr 0.5.2 (2026-01-30)

CRAN release: 2026-01-30

Fixed

  • AppenderFileRotatingTime: Fix the class being registered as AppenderFileRotating instead of AppenderFileRotatingTime, which broke R6 class dispatch

  • DESCRIPTION: Quote ‘Dynatrace’ and ‘lgrExtra’ package names

lgr 0.5.0 (2025-07-23)

CRAN release: 2025-07-23

Added

  • Layout: Add excluded_fields for excluding fields from logging

  • LayoutGlue: Support transformers (see ?glue::glue) (#51)

  • LayoutJson: Add transform_event and transform_event_names fields for more flexible event transformation; excludes rawMsg by default for backwards compatibility

  • LogEvent: Add a rawMsg property to store the message before string interpolation (i.e. the original string with unresolved sprintf()/glue() placeholders) (#60)

Changed

  • AppenderConsole: Accept a connection argument; defaults to stderr instead of stdout when called from a knitr rendering process, to avoid polluting markdown documents (#62, thx @gadenbuie)

  • Internals: Use isTRUE()/isFALSE() instead of identical(x, TRUE) for better performance (thx @m-muecke)

  • Internals: Use anyNA() and anyDuplicated() in more places for better performance (thx @m-muecke)

  • Logging: Replace NULL values and empty strings with the string "<NULL>" instead of an empty log message (#51)

lgr 0.4.4 (2022-09-05)

CRAN release: 2022-09-05

Added

  • LogEvent: Add as_LogEvent() to coerce event-like objects to LogEvents

Changed

  • Docs: Use the more common term “structured logging” instead of “custom fields” where appropriate

  • Docs: Rebuild documentation for compatibility with R 4.2.0

Fixed

  • event_list: Fix as_event_list.data.frame() not returning a list of LogEvents

  • format.LogEvent: Fix %k/%K parameters not working as expected with crayon terminal colours (#52)

  • LayoutGlue: Fix the default format string using msg instead of {msg} (#54, thx @mmuurr)

lgr 0.4.3 (2021-09-16)

CRAN release: 2021-09-16

Added

  • logger_index: Add logger_index(), returning a data.frame with metadata on all registered loggers (#47, thanks @Fuco1)

  • string_repr: Export the string_repr() generic used to format R objects for log message output (#48, thanks @mmuurr)

Changed

  • Logger: $log() now unpacks conditions passed to it (except when supplied as a named argument), for both Logger and LoggerGlue (#45, thanks @mmuurr)

Fixed

  • Tests: Fix timezone-related test failures on CRAN

lgr 0.4.2 (2021-01-10)

CRAN release: 2021-01-10

Changed

  • default_exception_handler: Throw more informative warnings when an error is encountered during logging

Deprecated

  • AppenderFileRotating: Deprecate the create_file argument; file creation is now always enabled (hardcoded to TRUE, since FALSE never made sense)

Fixed

  • Tests: Drop tests for deprecated future plans to maintain compatibility with upcoming future versions (#43)

lgr 0.4.1 (2020-10-20)

CRAN release: 2020-10-20

Added

  • AppenderFile: $show() can now filter log files formatted by LayoutFormat by log level (note: this greps the file, so it may return false positives when a log message itself contains level-like strings)

  • AppenderMemory: Add a $clear() method to clear the buffer without sending events to its attached appenders

  • LayoutJson: Add a timestamp_fmt field for custom timestamp formats (#34)

  • LogEvent: Add a toString() method for a compact representation of LogEvents

  • Logger: Add a $list_log() method

  • Utils: Export more utility functions useful for building custom Appenders, such as standardize_threshold() and event_list()

Changed

  • AppenderBuffer: Default flush_threshold to NULL (never flush based on the log level of an event); flush_threshold is now independent of should_flush

  • AppenderFile: $show() and $data now dispatch to Layout$read()/Layout$parse(), tying log file reading/parsing to the Layout used

  • AppenderFileRotating: Update AppenderFileRotating and related appenders for compatibility with rotor 0.3.0

  • Docs: Rewrite documentation to use the newer roxygen2 features for R6 classes

  • Errors: Give most errors appropriate subclasses

  • Tests: lgr is now automatically tested against all major R versions >= 3.2.0

Removed

  • Breaking: Move the more complex Appenders to the new lgrExtra package, including database Appenders, email and push notifications, and AppenderDt (in-memory data.table)

  • AppenderBuffer: Remove default_should_flush(), made unnecessary now that flush_threshold is independent of should_flush

Fixed

  • basic_config: Fix .jsonl file handling to work as documented

  • Logger: $log() now dispatches to all appenders even if one throws an error, instead of aborting after the first failing appender

lgr 0.3.4 (2020-03-20)

CRAN release: 2020-03-20

Fixed

  • Fix compatibility with R < 3.6.0 (#32)

lgr 0.3.3 (2019-09-27)

CRAN release: 2019-09-27

Fixed

  • Logger: Fix a performance regression in parent lookup that notably slowed down “do-nothing” logging (i.e. discarding a message below a logger’s threshold)

lgr 0.3.2 (2019-08-20)

CRAN release: 2019-08-20

Added

  • AppenderSyslog: Add AppenderSyslog for logging to syslog via rsyslog (thanks @atheriel)

lgr 0.3.1 (2019-06-13)

CRAN release: 2019-06-13

Added

  • Appender: Add print()/format() methods

  • AppenderMemory: Add data/dt active fields to return the log as a data.frame/data.table

  • logger_tree: Add logger_tree() for an overview of all registered loggers

Removed

  • Breaking: Remove the deprecated FATAL()/ERROR() functions; use lgr$fatal()/lgr$error() instead

Fixed

  • AppenderMemory: Fix $buffer_dt()/$show() not handling custom fields containing atomic vectors correctly

lgr 0.3.0 (2019-05-30)

CRAN release: 2019-05-30

Added

  • AppenderFileRotating: Add support for rotating log files via AppenderFileRotating, AppenderFileRotatingDate, and AppenderFileRotatingTime (requires the rotor package)

  • basic_config: basic_config() now accepts thresholds (e.g. "info", "fatal") as arguments to console and memory

  • Config: $config() now accepts YAML in addition to JSON, as files or as a character string

  • Config: $config(NULL) resets a Logger to its default/unconfigured state

  • get_logger: Add a reset argument to get_logger() that completely resets a Logger’s configuration and replaces special loggers (such as LoggerGlue) with vanilla ones

  • Root logger: The root logger can now be configured via options() and/or environment variables (see ?lgr)

Changed

  • AppenderFile: $new() now creates an empty file immediately, or fails if it can’t

  • Breaking: Change the default config of the root logger to have only a console appender with a default threshold of "info" (previously "all"). To restore the old behaviour, run basic_config(threshold = "all", console = "info", memory = "all")

  • RMariaDB: Improve support for RMariaDB and drop support for RMySQL

  • RPostgres: Improve support for RPostgres and drop support for RPostgreSQL

  • show_log: show_log(), show_data(), and friends now accept logger names in addition to Logger/Appender objects as target

  • with_log_level: with_log_level() and with_log_value() now accept logger names in addition to Logger objects as the logger argument

Deprecated

  • Deprecate FATAL()/ERROR(); use lgr$fatal()/lgr$error() instead

Fixed

  • get_logger_glue: Fix get_logger_glue() not working as intended

lgr 0.2.1 (2019-03-25)

CRAN release: 2019-03-25

Removed

  • Docs: Remove the .Rd file for the unexported LoggerRoot class

Fixed

  • Tests: Fix the test suite not cleaning up temporary files

lgr 0.2.0 (2019-03-22)

CRAN release: 2019-03-22

Added

  • Logger: Add an experimental $config() method for configuring Loggers via config objects and YAML files

  • Logger: New Loggers without an explicit threshold now inherit the threshold of their parent

  • with_logging: Add with_logging(), the opposite of without_logging(), for toggling logging on/off within specific unit tests

Changed

  • Breaking: Derive Logger inheritance from a Logger’s qualified name; lg$parent is now derived from lg$name and lg$set_parent() is no longer possible

  • Breaking: Remove the full_name active binding from Loggers; name is now always the fully qualified name (what full_name used to return); the ancestry format method was revised accordingly

  • Dependencies: Depend on R6 >= 2.4.0, which includes relevant finalizer fixes; finalize methods are now private

  • get_loggers: get_loggers() now registers new loggers in the lgr::loggers namespace, a more global and decoupled approach similar to Python’s logging module

lgr 0.1.1 (2019-02-22)

CRAN release: 2019-02-22

Added

  • show_data: Add show_data()/show_dt() for quick access to the root logger’s in-memory log as a data.frame/data.table respectively

Fixed

  • Docs: Remove non-breaking spaces from .Rd files, which caused problems compiling the PDF manual during CRAN submission

  • Numerous small fixes
